page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.cm4.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2667 v4 processor running at 3.2 GHz. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 16 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores falling in the middle 50% tier. However, single-core processing is a relative bottleneck, as stress-ng single-core CPU performance is categorized in the bottom 25%. Memory read bandwidth is average for both small and large blocks, but large block write bandwidth is weak, placing in the bottom 25% of tested instances.

This server is configured for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading. It is suitable for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, and database operations, as reflected in its average Passmark database and Redis SET performance. It is less suitable for single-threaded tasks or medium-to-large language model inference, where benchmarks show weak performance. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation provides predictable compute resources, though the older Intel Xeon E5 v4 architecture presents a performance-per-resource tradeoff compared to newer hardware generations.
